 Croatia 0 – 0 2:45 PM ET Czechia Live Updated 19 minutes ago Kick-off in 35 minutes Croatia vs Czech Republic LIVE, Latest Score, Goals and UEFA Nations League Updates
 Follow Croatia vs Czechia (Czech Republic) live at Opus Arena in Osijek: 2026 UEFA Nations League lineups, goals and updates with Ivan Perisic and Hlozek.
 Coverage by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta Updated November 15, 2026, 1:50 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 2:45 PM ET Last update 1:50 PM ET 1:50 PM ET 19 minutes ago Confirmed Croatia Starting XI (4-2-3-1)
 Croatia starting lineup (4-2-3-1): #1 Dominik Livakovic, #2 Josip Stanisic, #3 Luka Vuskovic, #5 Duje Caleta-Car, #4 Josko Gvardiol, #10 Luka Modrić, #8 Mateo Kovacic, #17 Petar Sučić, #16 Martin Baturina, #14 Ivan Perisic, #9 Dion Beljo. Substitutes: Niko Galesic, Lovro Majer, Ante Budimir, Ivor Pandur, Ivan Smolcic, Mario Pašalić, Simun Hrgovic, Marco Pašalić, Igor Matanovic.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 Follow VAVEL on Google 1:50 PM ET 19 minutes ago Confirmed Czech Republic Starting XI (4-3-3)
 Czech Republic starting lineup (4-3-3): #23 Antonín Kinský, #5 Vladimír Coufal, #6 David Zima, #3 Tomas Vlcek, #15 Jiri Slama, #21 Alex Král, #12 Lukas Cerv, #8 Michal Sadílek, #7 Idris Hopi, #10 Adam Hlozek, #11 Christophe Kabongo. Substitutes: Matej Kovar, Filip Prebsl, Adam Gabriel, Ryan Naderi, Lukáš Ambros, David Jurásek, Lukas Hornicek, Matěj Jurásek, David Kozel.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 1:32 PM ET 38 minutes ago Spain vs England runs simultaneously at 2:45 p.m. ET
 All four Group A3 nations kick off simultaneously at 2:45 p.m. ET: 15-point Spain face 12-point England for first place while 3-point Croatia and 0-point Czechia battle for survival in Osijek.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 1:12 PM ET an hour ago Ivan Perisic and Adam Hlozek lead the creative charts
 Veteran winger Ivan Perisic paces Croatia with 3 goal contributions (1 goal, 2 assists) in four matches, while forward Adam Hlozek leads Czechia with 2 assists and 7 shots across five appearances.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 12:50 PM ET an hour ago 581 combined passes from Vuskovic, Kovacic and Gvardiol
 Luka Vuskovic (206 accurate passes), Mateo Kovacic (196) and Josko Gvardiol (179) lead Croatia's buildup play in Group A3, setting the tempo alongside captain Luka Modric tonight.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 12:28 PM ET 2 hours ago Croatia 5-1 Czechia at Opus Arena in June 2025
 Croatia remain unbeaten in five all-time meetings against the Czechs (2 wins, 3 draws), highlighted by a 5-1 World Cup qualifying victory inside this exact Osijek stadium 17 months ago.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 12:06 PM ET 2 hours ago Why even a 1-0 Czechia win flips Group A3 third place
 Because Croatia enter at -11 overall goal difference (after losing 7-0 to England in October) and Czechia enter at -10, a one-goal Czech win in Osijek ties head-to-head (3-3 on aggregate) and hands Czechia third place on overall goal difference (-9 vs -12)!
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:45 AM ET 2 hours ago How to watch Croatia vs Czech Republic: US TV channel and live stream
 Croatia vs Czech Republic (Czechia) kicks off at 2:45 p.m. ET / 1:45 p.m. CT / 11:45 a.m. PT (19:45 UTC, 20:45 CET) today, Sunday, Nov. 15, at Opus Arena in Osijek. Fans in the United States can watch live television coverage on FS2 (Fox Sports 2) and ViX, with streaming available on Fubo and the FOX Sports app.
 League A survival hangs on every goal over the next two hours.
 Stay right here with VAVEL USA for confirmed starting XIs from Osijek, live goal alerts, cards, substitutions and final Group A3 relegation results.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:45 AM ET 2 hours ago Matchday 6 sportsbook odds from Osijek
 Oddsmakers install host Croatia as solid odds-on favorites to finish the job and clinch third place in Group A3.
 DraftKings prices Croatia at -180 on the three-way moneyline, with the draw at +300 and a Czechia road win at +425. On the goal handicap, Croatia stand at -0.5 (-180) against Czechia +0.5 (+145), paired with a 2.5-goal over/under line after three of their five historical meetings produced at least three total goals (2-2, 5-1 and 2-1).
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:45 AM ET 2 hours ago Set-piece threat represents Czechia's clearest route to an away win
 Because a 0-0 or 1-1 draw eliminates Czechia automatically, the visitors cannot sit in a passive 5-4-1 block past the hour mark tonight.
 In open play Czechia have scored only two goals across five Group A3 matches (one vs Croatia in Prague, one at Spain in October), making corner kicks and wide free kicks aimed toward 6-foot-4 Tomás Soucek and Ladislav Krejcí (4 shots) their highest-percentage weapon against Dominik Livakovic and Duje Caleta-Car.
 Whenever Czechia commit wingbacks Vladimír Coufal and David Jurásek high into the final third after halftime, Croatia's counter-attacking lanes open wide for Ivan Perisic and Igor Matanovic.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:45 AM ET 2 hours ago Inside Opus Arena: Croatia's modern 13,005-seat fortress on the Drava River
 Opened in 2023 on the banks of the Drava River in Osijek, the fully covered, steep-sided 13,005-seat Opus Arena generates some of the loudest acoustics anywhere in Balkan international soccer.
 Playing in Slavonia rather than Zagreb or Split paid massive dividends when Croatia dismantled Czechia 5-1 here in June 2025. Cool November evening air in eastern Croatia keeps the natural grass surface crisp for Modric and Kovacic's one-touch midfield triangles, with touchline stands sitting just six meters from the pitch.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:45 AM ET 2 hours ago Encouraging signs from Croatia's narrow 2-1 defeat at Wembley on Thursday
 Compare Croatia's October collapse against England (a 7-0 loss on Oct. 3) with Thursday night's 2-1 battle away to England on Nov. 12 and the defensive tightening is unmistakable.
 Four of Croatia's five Group A3 fixtures ended as one-goal contests: beating Czechia 2-1 away on Sept. 26, pushing Spain to a 2-1 finish at home on Oct. 6 and taking England down to the wire in a 2-1 defeat three nights ago. Playing back on home soil against an opponent outside the Spain-England bracket restores ball control to Modric, Kovacic and Martin Baturina.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:45 AM ET 2 hours ago Adam Hlozek, Tomas Soucek and Ladislav Krejci lead a Czechia squad without Patrik Schick
 Five consecutive defeats in a group alongside European champions Spain and England leave Czechia on zero points: 2-1 vs Croatia (Sept. 26), 2-0 vs England (Sept. 29), 3-1 at Spain (Oct. 3), 3-0 at England (Oct. 6) and Thursday night's 2-0 home loss to Spain on Nov. 12.
 With striker Patrik Schick absent from the November roster, forward Adam Hlozek carries the attacking load, pacing the Czech Republic in both assists (2) and total shots (7) across five appearances alongside forward Christophe Kabongo and energetic midfielder Lukás Cerv (3 shots). Defender Jiri Sláma owns Czechia's other Group A3 goal across four outings, while West Ham United regulars Tomás Soucek and Vladimír Coufal provide aerial presence on dead balls.
 Defensively, center-back Ladislav Krejcí leads the visitors with 144 accurate passes and 4 shots, flanked by Robin Hranác (133 passes) and Stepán Chaloupek (114 passes). Three Czech goalkeepers have split shot-stopping work across the campaign: Matej Kovár (7 saves), Antonín Kinsky (7 saves) and Lukás Hornícek (5 saves).
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:45 AM ET 2 hours ago Luka Modric, Ivan Perisic and Mateo Kovacic anchor Croatia's battle-hardened core
 Enduring four consecutive Group A3 losses against heavyweights Spain (4-1 away, 2-1 home) and England (7-0 home, 2-1 away on Thursday, Nov. 12) has tested Croatia's generational transition, yet Dalic's veteran spine remains intact for tonight's survival match.
 Evergreen captain Luka Modric (1 goal in five appearances) and rising midfielder Petar Sucic (1 goal in five matches) share top-scoring duties alongside wide stalwart Ivan Perisic , who paces the Vatreni in combined goal contributions with 1 goal, 2 assists and 6 shots across four outings. Tall striker Igor Matanovic leads the entire Croatian squad with 10 total shots plus 1 assist, giving Perisic and Josip Stanisic a prime aerial target inside the six-yard box.
 Behind them, teenage center-back sensation Luka Vuskovic tops Croatia's passing chart with 206 accurate passes, partnered by Manchester City midfielder Mateo Kovacic (196 accurate passes, 6 shots) and Manchester City defender Josko Gvardiol (179 accurate passes) in front of goalkeeper Dominik Livakovic (9 saves).
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:45 AM ET 2 hours ago Opus Arena memories: Croatia crushed Czechia 5-1 on this exact ground in June 2025
 History leans unmistakably toward the hosts across five previous international meetings, with Croatia unbeaten at 2 wins, 3 draws and 0 defeats against the Czechs.
 More strikingly still, these two nations met right here in Osijek just 17 months ago during 2026 FIFA World Cup qualifying on June 9, 2025, when Croatia tore Czechia apart in a 5-1 home rout! Four months after that five-goal explosion, they played out a 0-0 World Cup qualifying draw in Prague on Oct. 9, 2025, before Croatia returned to Prague seven weeks ago on Sept. 26, 2026 and claimed a 2-1 Nations League victory.
 Their other two meetings both ended level at European Championships: 2-2 at Euro 2016 in Saint-Etienne and 1-1 at Euro 2020 in Glasgow.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:45 AM ET 2 hours ago Exact League A Group A3 relegation math: why a draw saves Croatia and relegates Czechia
 Under UEFA Nations League rules, fourth place in League A suffers automatic relegation to League B, whereas third place enters a two-legged March relegation/promotion play-off against a League B runner-up.
 Croatia enter tonight holding a three-point cushion (3 points vs 0) AND the head-to-head advantage thanks to their 2-1 road victory over Czechia in Prague on Matchday 1 back on Sept. 26. Consequently, either a Croatia win or a draw in Osijek guarantees third place for Zlatko Dalic's side and sends the Czechs straight down to League B.
 For Czechia (Czech Republic), nothing short of an away victory works. Even a one-goal win in Osijek pulls both nations level on 3 points and 3 head-to-head points with level head-to-head goal difference: a two-goal Czech victory clinches third place outright on head-to-head goal difference, while a one-goal Czech win swings overall goal difference in Czechia's favor (-9 vs -12)!
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:45 AM ET 2 hours ago Direct League A survival clash in Osijek: Croatia host Czech Republic on Matchday 6
 Good afternoon and welcome to VAVEL USA's live minute-by-minute coverage of Croatia vs Czech Republic (Czechia) on Matchday 6 of League A Group A3 in the 2026-27 UEFA Nations League . Kick-off at Opus Arena in Osijek is scheduled for 2:45 p.m. ET (11:45 a.m. PT, 19:45 UTC and 20:45 CET local time).
 Top-flight survival comes down to 90 decisive minutes in eastern Croatia.
 With Spain (15 points, 5-0-0) and England (12 points, 4-0-1) already locking up the top two quarterfinal spots in a brutal Group A3, third-placed Croatia (3 points, 1-0-4, -11 goal difference) and fourth-placed Czechia (0 points, 0-0-5, -10 goal difference) battle directly to avoid automatic relegation to League B.
 Verified starting lineups arrive 60 minutes before kick-off, followed by live updates of every goal, card, substitution and head-to-head relegation tiebreaker.
